notes.content:

notes.title: Workshop Update is Finally LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]
[h3]Please prepare a round of applause for the newly introduced Steam Workshop![/h3]

[b]Today we’re finally ready to share with you the Steam Workshop Update We’ve mentioned a few times before! Thank you for your patience while we finished up a few things from our side![/b]

From the game side you’ll notice a new option in the Main Menu that will allow you to see the items downloaded from the Steam Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/2d1ed63872402e0600c57160accbb92c9370dcbd.png[/img]

There you should also have the option to send the items you’ve created directly into the Steam Workshop. To create your own item to the Steam Workshop open a tool that should be downloaded by default with the new update. To check if it’s installed properly first enter your library and change the visibility of tools.
[b]Press the list that should say “Games” or “All” and make sure the Tools section is marked.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/140cab0daff81f90f304be8c849fd808ded250bb.png[/img]

[b]Then Navigate to the Builder Simulator - Workshop Exporter (or search it via the search bar) and make sure it’s properly installed.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/7354503232f2a1761a74bb6428386765a7c7a8d6.png[/img]

Now you can press play on the Workshop exporter and the tool should guide you through the steps of creating your own item into the game. When the item is ready simply click [i]“Prepare Item”[/i] then [i]“Send Item”[/i] and Verify it on your Steam Workshop. After all that you’re ready to download the full item from the Steam Workshop [b](By default it’s unsubscribed so you need to subscribe it manually)[/b].

If you have any troubles with the Steam Workshop, we’ll prepare a more detailed tutorial in the next Devlog. Let us know if you need that in discussion under this Devlog.

Just before we finish everything up, we just wanted to remind you about the recent release of Builder Simulator VR, and about the special Bundle we’ve prepared just for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48617/Ultimate_Builder/

As always thank you for sticking with us until the end!
We can’t wait to hear your opinions and see the items you’ve created for the game!

[i]Cheers!
~Jacob and the Frozen Way Team![/i]

notes.title: Quality of Life update and a huge discount - Get your tools ready for -50%!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Renovators![/h3]

It's been a while since we last filled you in on the changes, and we know some of you might have been getting antsy. Despite the time that's passed since launch, we're still keeping an eye on your feedback, and we've decided to throw in a few improvements and tweaks to make your gaming experience smoother and more enjoyable.

So, without further ado, let's get down to the nitty-gritty…

[h3][b]NEW UPDATE[/b][/h3]

We're rolling out a small but game-changing update called [b]Quality of Life[/b]. 
From now on, you'll notice a snazzier UI. For those who like to zip around, teleportation is now a thing, making it quicker to get where you want... but let's take it step by step!

[b]NEW UI EXPERIENCE[/b]

We're putting our foot down on blurry and tiny interface elements! We figured it was time for a fix, so we've made some tweaks to our UI that you'll be able to see with your own eyes.
From now on, reading every element should be a breeze because we've decided to size up UI elements that might have been giving you headaches. 
Take a peek at a before-and-after, and let us know if you dig this change.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/c128783236747f8415e45a4dcb718d1b2fa33016.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/33f7acc44d453a09034541a747e48b6858a816e8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/5988faf3a04abd87420b5a0c273dc8059461e651.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/645c92fd8595becf44810dd4388dfcb4759a93f3.gif[/img]
[/list]

[b]TELEPORTATION[/b]

Now, brace yourselves for what many of you might deem a total game-changer. We've decided to toss in a teleportation option for Builder Simulator! 
With just a spin of the tool wheel, you can whisk yourself from one spot to another — imagine teleporting to snag that fresh batch of concrete, just like that. This nifty addition is set to turbocharge the construction of your dream homes, making it quicker and more efficient. How about that for leveling up the gameplay?

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/41e5f18b11facf61161aa93c313f4436f041e005.gif[/img][/list]

[b]GAME OPTIMIZATION[/b]

Every now and then, we all forget something, but games should be rock-solid in this regard. That's why we've gone the extra mile to introduce another minor enhancement and optimize the memory in Builder. We hope that now, even machines with less memory will run just as smoothly as the high-end ones.

[h3][b]NEWS SECTION[/b][/h3]

[b]DAILY DEAL[/b]

However, an update is not the only thing we have for you today. Join us in the news corner because there are a few Builder-related updates!
First up is the biggest discount we've ever had. It's up for grabs with the Daily Deal on Builder! Treat yourself to a sweet [b]50% off[/b] the regular price – a limited-time offer you won't want to miss.
Seize the opportunity now by clicking on the graphic below. 🎮💸

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120320/Builder_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/c24d5f810e28a2ed36c88d6dd40114f705aba3bc.png[/img][/url]

[b]STEAMDECK[/b]

You probably already know that the Steam Deck is your buddy for gaming on the go, but now that we've successfully passed certification, you can take Builder Simulator on a trip as well!

Keep in mind that, while the game is functional, some interactions or configurations might require a bit of extra effort.

For full Steam Deck support, we'll have to wait a bit longer, but that green checkmark is just a matter of time, so stay tuned! 🕹️✅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/8afa94fff1cc5f18067bb85cfa618fb04aca19fc.png[/img]

[b]NEXT UPDATE[/b]

For those playing on macOS, we have some news – an update for this system should be rolling out within the next month!

And as a very little bonus, we'd like to say that we're working on the smaller winter-style plot for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/87997fe5289614c53a3f5a26593e8635c0ac3612.png[/img]

[b]BUILDER SIMULATOR VR[/b]

And now, something for the house-building enthusiasts but with a twist from the everyday... Soon, you'll get to learn more about our project to bring Builder Simulator to the virtual reality system. We're not revealing too much just yet, but stay tuned because your VR-tual renovations are closer than you may think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/adc31680f8692845816830840b308695217cb489.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2270940/Builder_Simulator_VR/

[b]Honeycomb[/b]

Ever wanted to build in space? Our upcoming game, Honeycomb: The World Beyond, will let you do just that and a lot more. Explore a new world on an alien planet, build your base and try to learn from the native species as a bioengineer on a mission.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/ 

[h3][b]KEEP UP TO DATE[/b][/h3]

That's all for today, Renovators! We hope you like the changes we've implemented, and they prove beneficial to you. Feel free to drop us a comment if you have any thoughts!

As always, we encourage you to stay connected with us through our social media for the latest updates. And don't forget, for the next week, you can grab Builder at a [b]50% discount[/b] — perfect for a holiday treat!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120320/Builder_Simulator/ 

Have a great time builders!

Fufu and Frozen Way Team~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/5034bcd17df698ef44421146f738487c1caea623.png[/img]

As the last news for today, we’d like to say that Builder Simulator is having a Daily Deal and you can buy it 40% cheaper! Now’s the perfect time, to make yourself a gift, if you've had your eye on our game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120320/Builder_Simulator/

As always, we remind of our social media to be up-to-date with the fresh news.

See you next time, Builders! Have a happy Easter and lovely time Building!

notes.title: Builder Simulator Update 1.1 – It’s Pooltastic, but a little Swampy!
notes.content:
Sup, fellow Builders!

We are very happy to announce that [b]Pooltastic Update is LIVE![/b] 

Now it’s time to say some words to you, guys!

It was a rough time since the release, but now, it’s time to show you our gratitude! We want to thank you for all your support. Without you, Builder Simulator wouldn’t be at the current stage. It’s really important to us that you care, and engage. That’s why, we’ve gathered all of your feedback, and comments, and put them into motion. Day, after day, we’ve tried our best, to showcase you something new, and the fruit of our hard work is [b]this Pooltastic Update![/b] Feel the freshness of the news along with a specially created trailer! Without further ado…

[h2]Let’s jump into the pool![/h2]

https://youtu.be/JWstFLB1mNk

Within this update, you will find a fresh-new Progress Bar. Now you’ll know exactly where you are, and how much work is left to be done. The next one is the ability to replace doors and windows. You’ll also be able to select sills and have the possibility of replacing them at any time. We saw your questions, so now we can answer – the pools are waiting for you to place them, as you wish! If this isn’t enough, There's a brand-new Swamp level awaiting to see your dream houses rising up. Let the showcase begin!

[h2]Progress bar[/h2]

There is no more satisfying thing than seeing the progress of your work! While building our cozy place, we always think of the final results. The process is just a way to reach the goal. Check this new feature, and let us know in the comments section, what you think of it.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/ae1d991b5f5dbbeb6eef1d6ed33e46b5cf77b4b3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/05864d9884ddc13058c4bd65d0a7c067bd0dede7.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Windows and sills[/h2]

Windows are the eyes to the world of any home, so you should make sure that they're the best possible showcase of your home. From now on, you’ll have this opportunity, thanks to our selection system. Create your dream home with a beautiful exterior eye.

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/5c32d7d682f3d993fd47ae79564feecfd61a7b06.gif[/img]
[/list]

What would windows be without the sills! That's why we won't leave them completely bare! We've added an option to change them as well. So feel free to adjust them to your style, as you can see below. Also, we're constantly waiting for your feedback, so let us know in the comment section below what you think about such a mechanic?

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/ce02eadee9202d51476123541234e007b1061beb.gif[/img]
[i]PS: the same mechanic goes with replacing your doors[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Pools[/h2]

You don't have to think about going to the pool anymore, because the pool has just come to you! Your own villa with a wet spot and even a pink flamingo is something that is a dream of many people, and you get it now and here, in an update named after this feature! Prepare your swimsuit and jump into the whirlpool of ideas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/744f04110104e77b0a57878f32aa08e07bdc926e.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Location[/h2]

Wanna feel like playing Days Gone? This location gives us the same vibe! Encircle yourself in the autumn atmosphere, right now. With a new wetland and swamps-inspired biome coming in this update, you'll be thrown into the swampy climate of Louisiana. Decorate your home and create something that perfectly fits this boggy place! Don’t wait and grab your tools, because it’s hard terrain to perform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/bb328d76d9c17b017a15d4088bc0bea060822e51.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/1ece6adcdcd196b52b7fddc58c2c52f7a22fd1cd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/3d110514e07462e181e7ef91da0b0b509ce2c63a.jpg[/img]

[h2]New pieces of furniture[/h2]

However, it's still summer, so let's not jump into such humid places yet. Let's feel that sunny delight by choosing brand-new furnishings for your homes. Inspired by a pool setting, these items will enhance your cozy spots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/b98089cff78b47d144e8bec0c6413a4f4553f3b8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/1e48b3d9dc94e447cfcc0033a80bcb847291e240.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/91dfd013d0292549a2edbf723d8cceecf6d5a0ad.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/1694191054c9ce40ed9ad425959000e539ade7a4.png[/img]

[h2]Keep up to date![/h2]

That would be it for today’s Pooltastic update. We hope that you’ve enjoyed the showcase and are as excited as we are! We look forward to hearing from you in the comments section below, so throw your feedback at us, anytime!

Last but not least, the Builder Simulator is currently on sale, so if you still didn't manage to grab yourself a copy, now it's the time. With 20% off,  you'll be able to build your dream house from scratch, so don't hesitate, and check it out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26521/Builder_Flipper/

Also, don’t forget to check our social media and discord channel to stay up-to-date with the updates.

Meanwhile, have a fantastic building time!

~Live Motion Games team

notes.title: Contracts and sandbox modes!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

[h2]
I've heard you've got an appetite for more… gameplay! 🔨🔧 So here we come with some juicy stuff! Only 2 days left to the launch, and we are sooo excited. 😍🎉✨

[/h2]

First of all, get to know our [b]contracts mode[/b]! 🤖👷‍♂️

Bill Derr guides you through assignments, so you can learn and do commissioned work! There are 10 contracts to complete. 

Are you an achievement-hunter player? 🏆 Within the contracts, you complete specific tasks that will earn you rewards for your collection. The more contracts you complete, the more skills you develop! 💎

[previewyoutube=E329_IAiokI;full][/previewyoutube]

This mode will prepare you for the possibilities of the sandbox mode. 🎆

After completing your contracts, you are ready for real, creative, unlimited building -and that's what you'll find here! 🏠

You can design and build a house exactly as you plan it, and in the end, finish and furnish it. 🛁🪑

Oh, and if you don't feel encouraged to design a house and would most like to start building right away, you can use pre-made designs! 

Sandbox mode gives you a choice of 8 different levels, where you can build on 3 plots. That's a total of 24 parcels waiting for your ideas! 🤩🎁

No budget, no guidance (no Bill), no need to use scaffolding – only freedom and fun! 

Build a breathtaking house and remember one essential thing – use a [b]photo mode[/b], take a picture, share it with your friends and show them you slay! ⭐📷

notes.title: Devlog #17 - ”Formworks and Reinforcements”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

[h2]It's time for a short sneak-peek into our development - let's see some of the mechanics improved and enhanced![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/053589eb027410a7baf14b0cdb149bcc8f2bca27.jpg[/img]

First of all - we are very thankful for all feedback we've been able to gather up until this point. We know that you are still full of great ideas and suggestions and we can't wait to read about them and implement them into our work. In this devlog we're showcasing some of the changes we've introduced to the game in comparison to the playable demo. A lot is changing and a lot will be changed in future too - of course we'll be here to let you know about those changes via our devlogs! 

Now without further ado, let's do it!
 
[previewyoutube=-PLvu8N-Hk4;full][/previewyoutube]

The first change is a very vital one. We've received numerous reports about motion sickness being a problem when playing games featuring first person view. As soon as we've noticed that we've started doing our best to make sure that game will feature counter-measures that would affect players experiencing these kind of issues positively. We hope that changed way of walking of our character alongside many other tweaks and improvements to the overall way the game is displayed will make it accessible to all players! 

[previewyoutube=JApP_7yv3iA;full][/previewyoutube]

We're also making changes to many of the mechanics that you might have witnessed in the demo. In this case we've been working on a way to make sure that the process of installing the formworks and reinforcements remains visually pleasing and satisfying experience while giving it the extra oomph and quality-of-life adjustmentes. As you can see in the video above you'll be still able to place the particular elements manually one by one but if you want to increase the speed of the process - nobody is stopping you! 

[previewyoutube=xpweq19cdYo;full][/previewyoutube]

The same goes for the reinforcements, as shown above. To add to it we've been also working on creating new animations for our mechanics - you might expect better, snappier and more fitting animations of particular features to enhance your fun and immersion in the game! 

[i]Hope you had fun reading our devlog - make sure to tune in again next time![/i]

Best regards,

notes.title: Devlog #13 - ”Buildings in the vicinity - a look at the area #2”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Builders![/h1]

[h2]We're coming back to the topic of the buildings you might see in different areas we're planning for the game.[/h2]

Being a Builder can be a really fun job! If you like what you do you can not only feel satisfied by the effects of your work and seeing how slowly it takes the desired shape but also you might have the opportunity to visit various places. Some of them can even leave a lasting impression on you! Builder Simulator will strive to emulate that feeling by letting you do the work in a variety of conditions and settings. This time we'll show you a bit of what we're working on - the word is "suburbs"! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/5b792df4b71944d5619ee40329652d7cc319f419.png[/img]

In this particular area, full of lovely houses and cozy buildings, you definitely don't want to break the overall image of the location. You will have to remember that building is never happening in a vacuum - there are other structures around your construction site and your building might either add to the overall quality of the place and make it even more lovely or can absolutely shatter the painstakingly created vision of other citizens. While it's a demanding job it might definitely offer a lot of satisfaction if we were to create a building that would be then called a "cherry on top" for this particular place.

We bring up the demo because even in the very early demo we still were able to showcase our approach and let you see how important and vital is environment for us. We want you to build houses in a world that is not empty and void of life but in a place that you can feel is inhabitated and full of life. In the demo we've used several objects and buildings to that effect - you're able to check boat slowly drifting on the closeby waters, you could visit the neighbours' little house and even check their car! All of those little things are not random but are an effect of careful planning on our part.

In reality we think level or two deeper. It's not enough for us to create a visually pleasing model of a house - we also think about its interior, about its plan of rooms and corridors. We plan what different areas of the house will be designed for and what you can expect to see if you had the chance to peek inside. Those houses are all hosts for families and we do not want to forget about that. 

In the future you will be the one to design great houses and homes that many people would love to live in. Make sure to plan accordingly as you will be the one who will ultimately decide whether your creation will be loved by everyone or scoffed at.

Starting from now on you will be able to sign up for a beta test on the main page of the game on Steam. We are hoping to gather as much feedback from those lucky fellows as possible - all for the task of making our game the best it could be!

As it is a [b]beta test[/b] you need to remember that some of the things might be still not fully implemented or might work in an inappropriate way. Please do remember that it is the nature of beta tests to find out what is working well and what is working… not quite as good. We’re hoping to hear back from you about any issues you might encounter during tests as we will be closely monitoring your suggestions, opinions and feedback. Your words are what matters the most! 

However we do hope that you will have fun during your tests and you will be able to feel the spirit of a true builder! Your tools and plans await you and we hope your creation will be legendary!
